press_references.value: Pipedrive MCP Connector Is Now Available in Claude's Official Marketplace

product_launches.description: Pipedrive made the Pipedrive MCP Connector available in Anthropic’s Claude marketplace, allowing users to connect Pipedrive CRM data and actions to Claude. The connector supports retrieving and updating CRM records, managing leads, and capturing meeting information.

press_references.value: Pipedrive Launches Native MCP Server, Bringing CRM Workflows Directly Into AI Assistants

product_launches.description: Pipedrive launched a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude securely access and act on live Pipedrive CRM data, enabling natural-language workflows and automations from within AI interfaces.

press_references.value: Pipedrive Accelerates Australian Growth With Sydney Data Centre and Local Expansion

product_launches.description: Pipedrive launched a Sydney-based data centre on AWS to host Australian customer data locally, cutting CRM latency by up to 60% and supporting Australian data residency and compliance needs.

press_references.value: New Pipedrive App in ChatGPT Now Available for Pipedrive Customers

product_launches.description: Pipedrive launched a new ChatGPT app integration that lets Pipedrive customers access and analyze their CRM data directly within ChatGPT to speed sales workflows.

press_references.value: Pipedrive Launches Smart Prospecting Toolkit ‘Pulse’ and Revamps Plans to Help Businesses Focus, Prioritize and Grow

product_launches.description: Pipedrive launched 'Pulse', a smart prospecting toolkit designed to help sales teams focus on best-fit leads, automate nurturing, and manage pipelines more efficiently. The launch also includes enhancements like Team Inbox and branched automations to boost productivity.

press_references.value: Pipedrive Introduces AI-Powered Report Creation to Simplify Sales Insights

product_launches.description: A feature that allows users to generate customized reports using natural language prompts, powered by OpenAI’s generative AI technology.

product.description: An AI-powered feature that provides sales insights, deal predictions, and personalized recommendations to optimize sales efforts.

product.name: Pipedrive Workflow Automation
product.description: Tools to automate sales processes including lead routing, follow-ups, and task management to reduce manual work.

product.name: Pipedrive Marketplace Integrations
product.description: A platform offering over 500 integrations with third-party apps for lead generation, communication, project management, and marketing.

product.description: Mobile applications for Android and iOS that allow sales teams to access and manage CRM data on the go.
